filesystem.description: Gives Claude direct filesystem access within the project root. Replace the path argument with your actual project directory.

github.description: GitHub MCP server — enables Claude to read issues, PRs, and repo metadata. Replace the token value with a real PAT that has repo scope.

postgres.description: PostgreSQL MCP server — lets Claude inspect the schema and run read-only queries. Replace the connection string with your local DB URL. NEVER point this at a production database.

brave-search.description: Brave Search MCP server — allows Claude to search the web. Requires a Brave Search API key from https://api.search.brave.com/.
